source: 1968 Chevrolet Chassis Service Manual, Brakes, p.5-26

procedures.title: Disc brake caliper: remove, overhaul and install
steps: (Removal) Put the car on a hoist.
Front caliper: disconnect the brake hose at the line support bracket. Corvette rear caliper: disconnect the brake tube from the inboard caliper half. Tape the open line or tube end.
Pull the cotter pin from the shoe retaining pin, then remove the pin and shoes (two pins on Corvette heavy-duty front calipers). Mark inboard and outboard shoes if they will be reused.
Free the hose end at the bracket by taking off the U-shaped retainer and pulling the hose out.
Remove the 2 hex head bolts and lift the caliper off its mounting bracket.
(Disassembly) Clean the caliper outside with Declene or equivalent. Corvette front caliper: remove the brake hose.
notes: See figure 39 in the manual (exploded caliper: bolts, bleeder valve, caliper halves, piston springs, seals, pistons, boots, shoes, O-rings, retaining pin, cotter pin; Chevelle/Chevy II/Camaro shown).
